_comment: Indicator ID emission: numeric IDs are canonical for ALL internal logic; the submission Indicator ID column is driven by emission_scheme. Default 'numeric' (identity): it is GENERATED at load time over every legislation-mapped indicator in config/indicators.json, so a new indicator needs no edit here. The p_code scheme is the documented alternative and stays scoped to the Round 1 pillars it lists; never mix schemes in one export run. P-codes are positional aliases: P{p}-I{n} = {p}.{n}.
